author: Tynvale
body:
This is just a suggestion that I think a lot of people might like.

Having one more of the 10 lobbies only have TDM only maps or DTM only maps in their rotation would be good because:
- People that like TDM can constantly play it
- People that like the traditional DTM can not worry about having a TDM map coming up

So I was thinking out of the 10 lobbies:
- 3 TDM and DTM lobbies
- 4 DTM only lobbies
- 3 TDM only lobbies

What does everyone think???
